reviews.t: The chokehold these lashes have on me should be studied…
reviews.x: I AM IN LOVE OKAY??!! These lashes are amazing. They’re also very whispy and fluffy but dramatic at the same time. I am a girl who usually likes longer lashes (above 20mm), and these get the job done. I also got several compliments on these. Like runnn to go get these girl!!!

At first when I opened the package I was upset the picture on the site I didn't think was accurate. I decided to give them a try. As you can see because of chemo I don't have much eyelashes left Whoever doesn't love these gorge eyelashes Is insane they went on with ease and it was like they were meant for my eyes I am truly in love with these! Lightweight Full Easy to put on Flexibility  Only con is the 20 pack not the same quality which I had guessed. But that's ok with me I'm happy to buy the

[[VIDEOID:c72a5f1fa052d2b5464c403789b1fd71]] I only tried one style (also did not know it came in multiple) but im excited to test out the others! So far with some envy lash glue, lasted a whole night out including the next day at work cause i was too tired [lol] to take off my makeup. LOVE LOVE !
[[VIDEOID:3f1364d6c87ef86c716ceb942b56d75d]] Super long and curly they tickle my eyelids when I blink. Easy to apply, and comes with 10 pairs. Feel like quality lashes.

These are some of the best lashes i’ve purchased from amazon. They are so soft and fluffy and look great on the eyes. They are great for everyday wear and are not harsh on the eyes ! The shipping was great , I will buy these again .

The WT 02i lashes are the perfect pair for a dramatic cat-eye look!  These are my first pair of big, dramatic lashes, and I find them so comfortable to wear.  A potential downside is when I took these lashes out of the packaging, some of the outer lash bits got pulled off- so they are a little fragile.  Other than that, the lashes stay on really well with little glue.  I could also see myself trimming some pairs down to create different shapes. Since there are 10 pairs, I can have a variety for

I don’t usually write reviews but these are so pretty. I half lashed them on my eyes. They look so natural but full. The quality is amazing and the lash band sticks, I’ve had problems with other lashes where the band was too plasticy and wouldn’t stick to my eye with glue but I didn’t have this problem with these. I really recommend for those wanting subtle but foxy cute eyes

I purchased this product to attend a party. When I received them in the mail I was so excited. The lashes were packaged well. The lashes are light weight, easy to apply, and super fluffy. The band on the lash is flexible to shape any eye. Definitely purchase this product if you want  to “Ball on a budget” absolutely worth it
Love  these lashes they are easy to put on.So comfortable you get  many pairs. These lashes are  wispy.There is ten pairs and you can reuse them.
Received lashes WOW 10 pairs!! they’re wispy ..i love them,very cute and soft ,i will give these 100 likes I will buy more next time.

If I could give these 6 stars I would! My first time ever wearing half lashes and my experience was  • forgot I was wearing lashes because they are so light • incredibly easy for anyone to put on! • no need to worry about the corners lifting up because it’s barely noticeable if they do • wore comfortably for over 10 hours  What a great price for 10 lashes as well! These are perfect and I’ve already told so many people about them.

reviews.t: Amazing! I met my new favorite lash
reviews.x: I absolutely love everything about this lash. The curl pattern just makes my eyes pop. Very easy to trim if you need to. I've received so many compliments on how amazing and perfect my lashes look. Many people have said they look like extensions but unlike nope they're just strip lashes. I added the pictures to see how the lash is looked on 2 different days. I'm just in awe on how amazing I love them.

These are a little harder then most to put on but worth the time certainly worth the money!! Im glad i bought these!! They look good I get compliments out of the first pair I put on! Just make sure you get good eyelash glue first I personally am attached to the kids clear brand but everyone is different! But these are a bargain that’s worth getting!

[[VIDEOID:24aa766d136a416614fec4acad6f4517]] The quality is amazing! The lash hairs are light and fluffy and the length and density is just right. I am sooo obsessed with these! If you need a good lash then look no more!!
I love these because they are not to long to wear your glasses or sunglasses, yet full and beautiful!!!
They were nice but I’ve bought better ones

I was under the impression I was going to receive the cat eye lashes, the ones I got were not that. They were super curly and big on the ends. They're definitely cute, if you like real curly lashes that is .... These just weren't for me though. I would've much better appreciated the ones I ordered, but I still will be wearing them nonetheless, because they're still cute. I just have to put my pride aside.

[[VIDEOID:f9ab6c0218a275a8e45409bb7b24b044]] this lashes are soooo pretty!! they’re full, giving cat eye. i love how wispy they are. they give lash extensions. the lashes don’t irritate your eyes AT ALL, which i like a lot. these are my only go to lashes from now on!! trust me, get yourself a pair!!

[[VIDEOID:6053a8b253450d9d6f74440b6a9c865c]] They were a little long so I had to cut a centimeter off of the inside corners. They have a thin band so they're super light, they do touch my eyebrows if I'm looking way up but I like a dramatic lash. I use kiss brand lash glue with aloe.

These are beautiful on! They compliment my eyes and make them look bigger then they are❤❤. A tad heavier but for the volume it's worth it and not significant anyways. I just got them but they seem to be the type that is you are careful can use every day for awhile. So happy.
For the price of these lashes it is definitely worth it!!! I rarely buy things for myself so these were such a treat to have, I put them on for Halloween and everybody complimented my lashes 😉
Love the lashes the fullness the length I get so many compliments they just irritate my eye lids for some reason. Other then that I’ve had no complaints
These are so cute and they aren’t irritating at all which lashes tend to do to me I popped them on and I forgot I had them on. Love the pop look
Love the length the curve the fullness EVERYTHING!! I can wear them several times if I take them off at night. I need some more right now😩
Not exactly what I was expecting. They are a lot longer and not really cateye to me they look more like 2 daddy long legs

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as soft, fluffy, wispy, and lightweight.
Many customers find the lashes easy to apply and comfortable to wear.
Several reviewers mention receiving compliments and say the lashes look natural or like extensions.
Customers appreciate getting multiple pairs (10 pairs) and being able to reuse them.
A few reviewers note minor downsides, such as fragility when removing from packaging or being harder to apply.
